verdict.rationale: Exposing low-level engine settings such as mlock or mmap is a fair axis for a local model-serving tool, but nothing in the evidence pack shows Ollama documenting any such override. The only on-topic item is a community report that Ollama hides llama.cpp server configs behind its own 'sane defaults' and won't let users enable mlock, which points the opposite way. With no vendor claim to contradict, this is 'none' rather than 'disputed'.
